feature: The page shows a question box, the 2x2 setup grid with the default setup picked, and a Run button
Run shows the agent's answer with its citation
The path of the email lists each tool call and the email sent; the verdict shows the tokens, cost and latency
With the guardrail on, the verdict names the email Progent blocked
The setup grid switches the injection and the guardrail for the agent, and its note explains the picked setup
The Sources drawer lists the indexed filings and opens a filing's PDF in a new tab
The News panel shows what fetch_news returns, each item tagged as injected or clean, injected text shown when the injection is on
Clicking a news item opens it in a dialog, with the injected text marked
Each time the question box is cleared it suggests, in grey, the next sample not yet used in this browser; Tab fills it in
A setup cell with a recording writes its question and toggles, the Run note says it replays, and Run replays the recording for the picked setup
For a FinanceBench question, a Gold answer pill beside ANSWER shows the gold answer, and a verdict tag opens the LLM judge's reply
Sample chips write their question into the question box
